prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed landscape 16:10 cinematic illustration of GUIDO AND HIS TRAINER WALKING TO THE RING for Wrestling from Marigold, Chicago 1952. This comes between dressing-room departure and first-match corner preparation. Reference 1 is approved Guido facial identity: exact youthful clean-shaven face, dark wavy forelock, expressive dark eyes/brows, no beard or moustache. Reference 2 is approved Guido compact muscular build, NOT current wardrobe. Reference 3 is trainer identity/costume: stocky middle-aged Black man, receding short hair, neat thick black moustache, plain tobacco short-sleeve work shirt, charcoal trousers, off-white cotton towel around neck. Reference 4 is the FIRST-MATCH CORNER continuity authority: reproduce its OLD BORROWED plain dark-gray knee-length robe with frayed edges, small ragged split at lower hem near Guido's LEFT knee, loosely tied belt and slightly open chest. No lettering, MORETTI, embroidery, hood, fancy trim, luxury fabric or new robe. RIGHT wrist has narrow white athletic tape, LEFT wrist bare. Plain wine-red trunks rendered dark gray beneath robe, black wrestling boots with cream laces if visible.
SHOT: eye-level medium-wide frontal three-quarter view of Guido walking TOWARD CAMERA down a DIM NARROW AISLE, camera a little ahead of him looking back toward the dark entrance. Guido occupies center slightly RIGHT, complete head and body through at least shins, preferably boots with room margin. Head upright, gaze forward just past camera toward unseen ring, quiet tense resolve, no grin or theatrical scowl, hands loosely at sides with natural restrained arm swing, one normal walking step not lunging. Trainer walks HALF A STEP BEHIND him at screen LEFT, face visible and recognizable, watching the aisle calmly; keep his head/face unobstructed, no comforting touch or boxing pose. They are the only two people walking in aisle. Maintain believable relative height/build; Guido not a huge superhero.
FANS: period spectators sit/stand close along BOTH edges of a walkway barely wide enough for the two men staggered, rows of folding chairs and wooden seating edges visible; no metal barricades or modern arena tunnel. Fans mainly ordinary adults in 1952 shirtsleeves, modest suits and dresses; a few hats. Still BLANK, APPRAISING faces watch the unknown young wrestler pass, not angry, grinning, cheering, waving or holding signs. A few visible near faces at left/right edges, farther faces dissolve into shadow. They are ordinary people, NOT horror figures, zombies, dead-eyed clones or sinister caricatures. No hands reaching toward Guido. Intimate small wrestling hall, low ceiling and hazy darkness, not huge stadium. Modest foreground shoulder silhouettes at extreme edges add depth without blocking either protagonist.
LIGHT: STRICT BLACK AND WHITE / GRAYSCALE broadcast-era illustrated aesthetic. A pool of brighter ring light from BEHIND CAMERA falls across Guido's face and front of robe; aisle behind falls into dark charcoal haze, small dim ceiling bulbs recede overhead. Enough shadow detail to read fans' faces. No ring behind the men: the ring is AHEAD OF THEM, offscreen behind camera. No spotlit runway, modern screens, neon, smoke machine or glossy wet floor. Faint ambient cigarette haze only, not heavy smoke obscuring faces.
STYLE: match approved inked game art, confident tapered black outer contours, clear selected interior face lines, simplified flat grayscale shadow shapes, restrained texture, NO photorealism, detailed pores, airbrush gradients, glossy 3D, dense hatch shading or heavy baked grain. One coherent composition with 5% overscan for future slow backward-tracking/push impression; all characters grounded on same aisle floor. No baked dialogue, text, speech bubbles, captions, border, watermark, panel layout or UI. Keep lower 15% relatively quiet for future controls, but important robe tear readable just above that region.
